matches.rationale: No finding addresses the unrealistic conditional Gaussian assumption in Assumption 3.2.

Finding 1 points out a mathematical derivation error in Theorem 3.5, while ground truth 2 concerns the neglect of practical deviations (model gaps, non-Gaussian noise, finite data) making the guarantee overoptimistic. These are distinct scientific issues.
No finding discusses the asymmetric compute/inference step bias between PhySense and baselines.
No finding mentions cherry-picked sensor counts or missing error bars/confidence intervals; the one data integrity finding (2) targets a numerical inconsistency in Table 2, not selective reporting.
No finding addresses the exaggerated claim in the Abstract about state-of-the-art accuracy and theoretical guarantees without limitations.
No finding discusses inflated or misattributed references in the Introduction.
No finding covers missing ethical discussion (environmental impact, fairness, data privacy) in the Appendix.
No finding points out the overconfident rhetoric in the Conclusion that glosses over limitations.
No finding notes the inconsistency in optimization epoch counts between the main paper and appendices.
No finding addresses the omission of hyperparameter sensitivity analyses in the ablation studies.
No finding mentions the duplicated numbers in Table 6; the data integrity finding relates to Table 2.
No finding discusses the overstatement of PGD convergence guarantees under non-convexity and local minima.
No finding addresses the overinterpretation of visual sensor placement evidence in the figures.
No finding covers the omission of privacy/societal risks in the Broader Impacts statement claiming no negative social impacts.
No finding points out the use of strongly positive adjectives and subjective language in the Introduction.
